analyzed_vuln.description: Use-after-free due to incorrect shutdown order in zend_deactivate(): it calls shutdown_executor() before shutdown_compiler(). shutdown_executor() iterates EG(function_table) and dereferences zend_op_array fields (e.g., op_array->type/static_variables at zend_execute_API.c:285), but those op_array structures can still point into compiler arena memory that is later freed by shutdown_compiler() (zend_compile.c:431). With this PoV, stale function-table entries reference arena-backed op_array data that has been invalidated, leading to a UAF read in shutdown_executor.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered during request shutdown in php-fuzz-parser after malformed input creates non-persistent user functions/op_arrays that survive into deactivation. Data flow: fuzzer_do_request_from_buffer() -> php_request_shutdown() -> zend_deactivate(). In zend_deactivate, shutdown_executor walks EG(function_table) and reads op_array metadata; the PoV causes at least one entry to reference memory from CG(arena) that has been/falls invalid, so dereference at shutdown_executor line ~285 reads freed heap. No special runtime interaction is needed beyond reaching request shutdown with this crafted parser input.
